description: This is for all standard clients

panels.description: Breakdown of clients for each IDP. Note none stands for service account

targets.rawSql:
WITH standard_clients as (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    "public"."client"
  WHERE
    ("public"."client"."realm_id" = 'standard')
  
    AND (
      ("public"."client"."client_id" <> 'account')
    
      OR ("public"."client"."client_id" IS NULL)
    )
    AND (
      ("public"."client"."client_id" <> 'account-console')
      OR ("public"."client"."client_id" IS NULL)
    )
    AND (
      ("public"."client"."client_id" <> 'admin-cli')
      OR ("public"."client"."client_id" IS NULL)
    )
    AND (
      ("public"."client"."client_id" <> 'broker')
      OR ("public"."client"."client_id" IS NULL)
    )
    AND (
      (
        "public"."client"."client_id" <> 'realm-management'
      )
      OR ("public"."client"."client_id" IS NULL)
    )
    AND (
      (
        "public"."client"."client_id" <> 'security-admin-console'
      )
      OR ("public"."client"."client_id" IS NULL)
    )
    AND (
      "public"."client"."description" = 'CSS App Created'
    )
  ),
  all_clients_and_idps as (
    SELECT standard_clients.client_id, client_scope.name FROM standard_clients join client_scope_client on standard_clients.id = client_scope_client.client_id join client_scope on client_scope.id = client_scope_client.scope_id 
    where client_scope.name in ('idir', 'bceidbasic', 'bceidboth', 'bceidbusiness', 'azureidir', 'githubbcgov', 'githubpublic', 'idir-saml', 'bceidbasic-saml', 'bceidboth-saml', 'bceidbusiness-saml', 'azureidir-saml', 'githubbcgov-saml', 'githubpublic-saml', 'bcsc','digitalcredential','digitalcredential-saml') 
    OR client_scope.name LIKE 'bcsc%'
    order by client_id
  ),
  clients_without_idps as (
    select count(client_id) as no_idp_count from standard_clients t1 where not exists (
      select client_id from all_clients_and_idps where client_id = t1.client_id
    )
  )
  select name, count(client_id) as clients from all_clients_and_idps group by name UNION select 'none' as name, no_idp_count as clients from clients_without_idps order by name, clients desc;
